metadata.title: Predicted structures of tomato hydrolase-effector complexes (P69B, Pip1) from AlphaFold-Multimer, AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2
metadata.description: Predicted structures and per-model confidence data (pLDDT, PAE, ipTM, pTM) for ten tomato hydrolase-effector complexes (P69B with Ecp36, Epi1, EpiC1, EpiC2B, SSP1, Six15 and TIL; Pip1 with Epi1, EpiC1 and EpiC2B), each predicted with seven method and MSA-database combinations: Boltz-2 (ColabFold MSAs and reduced-database MSAs), AlphaFold 3 (local, reduced and full-database MSAs), AlphaFold Server, and AlphaFold-Multimer v3 (full and reduced databases). AlphaJudge interface metrics for every model are included. See README.md for file layout, software versions and parameters.
